يستغربوا (form X)
# يَسْتَغْرِبُوا (yastaḡribū) /jas.taɣ.ri.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
# يُسْتَغْرَبُوا (yustaḡrabū) /jus.taɣ.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
